sentences.en: INTERVIEWER: wonder if you could spare a few minutes to do a survey on transport.
sentences.zh: INTERVIEWER: 不知您是否能抽出几分钟时间，协助我们完成一项关于交通的调查。

sentences.en: The survey is on behalf of the local council.
sentences.zh: 本次调查是受当地议会委托开展的。

sentences.en: They'd like to know about what transport you use and any suggestions for improvement.
sentences.zh: 他们希望了解您日常使用的交通方式，以及您对改善交通状况的任何建议。

sentences.en: Can I start by asking you how you travelled to town today?
sentences.zh: 我可以先问问您今天来镇上是乘坐什么交通工具吗？

sentences.en: Now can I get a few details about yourself?
sentences.zh: 接下来，我可以向您了解一些个人信息吗？

sentences.en: INTERVIEWER: Can you spell that, please?
sentences.zh: INTERVIEWER: 请问您能拼写一下您的姓氏吗？

sentences.en: And can I have your address?
sentences.zh: 另外，能告诉我您的住址吗？
那里是布拉德菲尔德，对吗？
INTERVIEWER: 邮政编码是 GT7 吗？

sentences.en: And could I ask what your job is?
sentences.zh: 另外，能请问一下您的职业吗？

sentences.en: LUISA: I've actually just finished my training.
And one more question in this section.
sentences.zh: 这部分还有最后一个问题。

sentences.en: What is the reason for you coming into town today?
sentences.zh: 您今天来镇上的原因是什么呢？

sentences.en: LUISA: Actually it's not for shopping today, which would be my normal reason, but to see the dentist.
sentences.zh: LUISA: 其实今天不是来购物的——这通常是我来镇上的原因——而是去看牙医。

sentences.en: INTERVIEWER: Now in this last section I'd like you to give us some ideas about the facilities and arrangements in the city for getting to and from work, er, any suggestions you have for improvements.
sentences.zh: INTERVIEWER: 现在，在最后这一部分，我想请您就本市上下班通勤的设施与安排提出一些建议，呃，任何您认为可改进之处。

sentences.en: LUISA: Well, something I've thought about for some time is that when I do walk and I'm doing a later shift, I think the lighting should be better.
sentences.zh: LUISA: 嗯，我考虑过一段时间的一点是：当我步行上下班、尤其是上晚班时，我觉得道路照明应该更好一些。

sentences.en: LUISA: And of course, I think it's a real shame they've been cutting down on the number of footpaths.
sentences.zh: LUISA: 当然，我认为他们大幅缩减人行道数量实在令人遗憾。

sentences.en: They should have more of those.
sentences.zh: 这类人行道应该多建一些。
这样人们才会更愿意步行。

sentences.en: LUISA: And, I don't think there are enough trains.
sentences.zh: LUISA: 而且，我觉得目前的火车班次不够多。

sentences.en: That's why I don't use them - you have to wait so long.
sentences.zh: 这正是我不乘坐火车的原因——等车时间太长了。

sentences.en: And finally I'd like to ask your opinion on cycling.
sentences.zh: 最后，我想请教您对骑自行车的看法。

sentences.en: As you may know, there's a drive in the city to get more people to cycle to work.
sentences.zh: 您可能知道，本市正在推行一项鼓励更多人骑自行车上下班的行动。

sentences.en: INTERVIEWER: But we realise that there are things which the council, but also employers, might do to help encourage workers to cycle to work.
sentences.zh: INTERVIEWER: 但我们意识到，市政委员会以及雇主们或许可以采取一些措施，来鼓励员工骑自行车上班。

sentences.en: Well, have thought about it and where I work there are no safe places to leave your bikes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我考虑过这个问题，而我工作的地方根本没有安全的地方停放自行车。

sentences.en: LUISA: And also, I'd have to cycle uphill and on a hot day I'd arrive at work pretty sweaty so I think I'd need a shower somewhere at work.
sentences.zh: LUISA: 而且，我还得骑车上坡，大热天到达公司时会出很多汗，所以我觉得我在公司里需要有地方洗澡。

sentences.en: LUISA: And I suppose the last thing is that I wouldn't be all that confident about.
sentences.zh: LUISA: 我想最后一点就是，我对这一点其实并不太有信心。
在如此繁忙的道路上骑车。

sentences.en: I think I'd like to see you offering training for that, you know, I'd feel a lot better about starting if that was the case.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果你们能提供这方面的培训，我会非常欢迎——要知道，如果真有这样的培训，我开始骑车上班时会安心许多。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您抽出宝贵时间。
